title: Energy & power
summary: Filtration as foundational infrastructure for incumbent and emerging energy systems.
paragraphs: The energy transition is not only about generation and vehicles — it also depends on technologies that keep systems running efficiently, reliably and cleanly. Filtration protects turbines, battery thermal loops, data centres and air/water processes.

Across both traditional and emerging platforms, contamination control helps cut emissions, extend asset life and meet tighter standards. Well-specified air filters are often one of the lowest-cost paths to better operational performance.
